items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1958-05-24
items.q: Black Baby played the... Washboard. Johnny played the... The Phoenix thing... And that sounded good too, partner.

ctx.x: No, Bannister played the tough bass. Oh, yeah. Gene Brickley. Black Baby played the... Washboard. Johnny played the... The Phoenix thing, like I was telling you about. And I was... The... The deal. Johnny Hill, what's the name for? Oh, yeah. Juice out. Oh, yeah. Juice out, yeah. And that sounded good too, partner.
Would they hold on for a whole night in one place?
